description: Korean maternity leave pay (출산전후휴가 급여) and spouse childbirth leave (배우자 출산휴가 20일) for 2026: monthly ordinary wage, priority-support (SME) employer or not, single / multiple / premature birth. Splits employer and employment-insurance shares with the 2026 caps (2.2M KRW per 30 days; 20-day spouse cap 1,684,210 KRW) and the minimum-wage floor.
